title: pelargonium pilosellifolium
intro: Pelargonium pilosellifolium, commonly known as Mountain Geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as digestive problems, fever, and skin irritations, thanks to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to the plant's ability to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Pelargonium pilosellifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
